audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Gnar five of seven rows at 2/10 while every corresponding why said 'Illaoi-favoured', the packet chart says Illaoi from level 3 on, and Illaoi wins 54.99% over 902 games. The page also read FAV / 8.5-10 difficulty / red tone for a matchup she wins.
audit.why: Both layers rendered a losing lane on top of prose describing a winning one.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Gnar / Skill / Illaoi x5 in both layers as one atomic group with ratings to match, and diff, tone, diffRating, the difficulty line, the rating line and the chart blurb brought into agreement.

audit.why: The spike prose already reads correctly: W at 2-3 breaks his kite, level 6 punishes a committed Mega Gnar, first item turns tentacles into sustained DPS.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown line told the player to 'track GNAR! and engage when it is down'. Transforming into Mega Gnar is driven by the Rage bar, not a cooldown — there is nothing to time. GNAR! (R) itself is Mega-only at 90/60/30s.
audit.why: The real trackable numbers are Hop (E) at 22s rank 1 — his only escape — and Harsh Lesson's flat 4s, which lets Illaoi re-leap every trade. Leap of Faith grounds, so it denies Hop entirely.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and the loading line retargeted onto the rage bar and Hop's 22s, with the grounding interaction stated.

audit.why: No number appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Hop 22s, GNAR! 90s and Harsh Lesson 4s now carry the sequencing advice.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rage: not a cooldown — watch the bar, not a timer, and fight him at empty rage. - Hop (E): 22s at rank 1, his only escape. - GNAR! (R): 90s at rank 1. - Harsh Lesson (W): flat 4s, so you re-leap every trade.

edits.before: His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rage is a bar, not a timer — commit while the bar is empty and he is mini.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Hop (E) is his only escape at 22s rank 1 — Leap of Faith grounds it, so ult and he cannot leave your tentacles.

edits.before: - Illaoi vs Gnar - Track: Gnar GNAR!. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on GNAR!'s cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Illaoi vs Gnar - Track: Gnar's rage bar. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage while he is still mini. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.

notes: This page was rendering a lost lane on top of prose describing a won one — five chart rows at 2/10 for Gnar under whys that all read 'Illaoi-favoured', against a 54.99% win rate. Also removed the 'track GNAR! cooldown' framing repeated in five fields: Mega transformation runs off the Rage bar, so there is no cooldown to track. The real timer is Hop at 22s, and Leap of Faith's grounding denies it.
